title: Bougie Broadway- East Nashville
description:
Welcome to Bougie Broadway! Located in highly desired urban style neighborhood of East Nashville. Walking distance to tons of restaurants, coffee shops, breweries, entertainment options, and only 8 minutes from broadway! After a day of jam packed exploring come back and relax in your 3 story escape. 4 beautifully designed bedrooms each with the privacy of their own bathroom. A fully upgraded kitchen stocked with essentials. Plus, a top story balcony with lounge area.

The space
Bed Setup:
Primary Bedroom (2nd level): King bed with detached bathroom
2nd bedroom (3rd level): Queen bed with en-suite bathroom
3rd bedroom (3rd level): 2 Queen beds with en-suite bathroom
4th bedroom (1st level): Queen bed with en-suite bathroom

Rooftop Balcony (3rd level) 
Private balcony with outdoor lounge area and selfie wall. 

2nd bedroom (3rd level)
Queen bed with smart TV and en-suite bathroom. Bathroom includes dual vanity and shower/tub combo.

3rd bedroom (3rd level)
2 Queen beds with smart TV and en-suite bathroom. Bathroom includes dual vanity and stand up tile shower. 

Master bedroom (2nd level)
King bed with smart TV and detached bathroom. Bathroom has dual vanity with shower/tub combo.

Kitchen (2nd level)
Fully equipped kitchen stocked with basic cooking essentials and complete with breakfast bar seating.

Living Area (2nd level)
Naturally bright and spacious living area complete with designer furnishings and large smart TV. 

4th bedroom (1st level) 
Queen bed with smart TV/ desk area and en-suite bathroom. Bathroom includes shower/tub combo.

Washer/Dryer (1st level) 
Stacked washer and dryer are located in the 4th bedroom, in utility closet. 

Garage (1st level)
2 car garage

Guest access
Self Access with door code.
